BiblicalUsage: Chomet is a snail, or a lizard that creeps, named once among the unclean creeping things. It stands in the list with the ferret and the chameleon, small creatures that defile by their touch, and the law marks them so Israel will learn to keep clean from what creeps.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a snail in the law teaches me that God marks the boundary between clean and unclean with care.
